name: content-agent
description: 基于项目知识库与可版本化公式的小红书完整内容生成 Agent

scripts.build: npm run build -w @content-agent/agent-core && npm run build -w @content-agent/agent-harness-core && npm run build -w @content-agent/web && npm run build -w @content-agent/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @content-agent/api" "npm run dev -w @content-agent/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @content-agent/agent-core && npm run test -w @content-agent/agent-harness-core && npm run test -w @content-agent/web && npm run test -w @content-agent/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @content-agent/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @content-agent/agent-harness-core && npm run typecheck -w @content-agent/web && npm run typecheck -w @content-agent/api
